newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy think tank says spring CPI can fall to 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy think tank says spring CPI can fall to 2 pct.

text.p: Consumer price inflation could fall further in the coming months after easing to 2.4 percent year-on-year in February from 2.6 percent in January, an economist with research institute Prometeia said.

Angelo Tantazzi told a committee hearing of the lower chamber of the Italian parliament that year-on-year consumer price inflation could fall to two percent in the spring but would rise again in the second half.
Average inflation for the whole year could amount to 2.4 percent compared with a government forecast of 2.5 percent.
Preliminary consumer price inflation figures for March are due to be released by 11 Italian cities on Thursday and Friday.
Economists polled by Reuters are forecasting a fall in the year-on-year inflation rate to 2.3 percent in March. --Milan newsroom +392-66102321
